title: Evaluation as a path expansion
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $T$ be a binary decision tree with real outputs, whose queries are restricted to a set $I$ of the $n$ coordinates. For every input $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, the evaluation of $T$ equals the sum, over all paths of $T$, of the path's output multiplied by the indicator of the set of inputs matching that path's queried coordinate values.
